stories.title: Assemblée générale de l'ONU : l'Iran n'a "jamais été un agresseur, n'a jamais démarré de guerre", lance le président iranien

en.title: UN General Assembly: Iran has "never been an aggressor, never started a war," says Iranian president
en.summary: Iranian President Massoud Pezeshkian stated at the UN General Assembly that powerful nations appear responsible for global instability and destruction, while characterizing Iran as having never initiated aggression or warfare.

stories.title: Visite de Xi Jinping aux Etats-Unis : comment la Chine a inversé le rapport de force face à Donald Trump

en.title: Xi Jinping's visit to the United States: how China reversed the balance of power against Donald Trump
en.summary: As President Trump hosts Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Washington, China appears to have secured favorable conditions by leveraging America's military and domestic political weaknesses.

stories.title: Guerre au Moyen-Orient : le président iranien affirme que son pays a été «victime du terrorisme»

en.title: Middle East conflict: Iranian president states his country has been "victim of terrorism"
en.summary: At the UN General Assembly, Iranian President Massoud Pezeshkian described the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei as an "assassination" and characterized Iran as a terrorism victim.

stories.title: La Cour de cassation annule en partie la condamnation de Mohamed Lamine Aberouz pour l'attentat de Magnanville, un nouveau procès va avoir lieu

en.title: France's Court of Cassation partially overturns conviction of Mohamed Lamine Aberouz in Magnanville attack; new trial to take place
en.summary: The Court of Cassation has partially annulled the conviction of Franco-Moroccan Mohamed Lamine Aberouz, who maintains his innocence in a 2016 police officers' killing in the Yvelines. He will face retrial on charges of complicity in unlawful detention.

stories.title: ONU : le président iranien à New York, du jamais vu pour un pays en guerre avec les États-Unis

en.title: UN: Iranian president in New York, unprecedented for a country at war with the United States
en.summary: Iran's president traveled to New York on September 23 to address the UN General Assembly, an unprecedented occurrence for a nation in conflict with the United States. This situation occurs only within the context of the annual UN General Assembly.

stories.title: Azerbaïdjan : grâce présidentielle pour le Français emprisonné Martin Ryan après la levée des sanctions européennes contre un oligarque

en.title: Azerbaijan: presidential pardon for imprisoned Frenchman Martin Ryan after lifting of European sanctions against oligarch
en.summary: A French businessman imprisoned in Azerbaijan since 2023 on espionage suspicions has received a presidential pardon. His release followed negotiations regarding the lifting of European sanctions against Russian-linked oligarch Alicher Usmanov, requested by France.

stories.title: Affaire Hakimi : un procès pour viol confirmé par la Cour de cassation

en.title: Hakimi case: rape trial confirmed by Court of Cassation
en.summary: France's highest court dismissed the appeal of PSG vice-captain Achraf Hakimi on September 23, confirming his referral to criminal court for a rape trial. The Moroccan international will face proceedings before the Hauts-de-Seine criminal court.

stories.title: La Cour de cassation confirme le renvoi en procès pour viol du footballeur Achraf Hakimi : «Ma cliente se battra jusqu’au bout»

en.title: Court of Cassation confirms rape trial for footballer Achraf Hakimi: "My client will fight to the end"
en.summary: France's highest court on September 23 confirmed that PSG player Achraf Hakimi will stand trial before criminal court on rape charges. The Moroccan international has consistently denied the allegations against him since the proceedings began.

stories.title: Aide aux grands rouleurs de 100 euros : comment en bénéficier ?

en.title: 100-euro aid for high-mileage drivers: how to benefit?
en.summary: The government announced 450 million euros to extend a support program through year-end, benefiting 5.5 million people with a three-month extension.

stories.title: Un rempart gaulois découvert sur l’île de la Cité, une « avancée majeure » quant aux origines de Paris

en.title: A Gallic rampart discovered on Île de la Cité, a "major breakthrough" regarding Paris's origins
en.summary: A stone and wood wall approximately twenty meters long was uncovered beneath Hôtel-Dieu on Île de la Cité, potentially representing a rampart from ancient Lutèce mentioned by Julius Caesar in 52 BCE.

stories.title: L'Azerbaïdjan accorde une grâce présidentielle au Français Martin Ryan, emprisonné pour "espionnage"

en.title: Azerbaijan grants presidential pardon to French national Martin Ryan, imprisoned for "espionage"
en.summary: Azerbaijan has pardoned French citizen Martin Ryan, who was imprisoned on espionage charges. Another French businessman, Anass Derraz, remains imprisoned after being sentenced to 12 years for accepting a bribe from a Russian oligarch.

stories.title: "Un spectacle qui nous fait honte" : Emmanuel Macron critique l'action israélienne en Cisjordanie et à Gaza, l'Etat hébreu dénonce une "absurdité grotesque"

en.title: "A spectacle that shames us": Emmanuel Macron criticizes Israeli action in the West Bank and Gaza, Israel denounces "grotesque absurdity"
en.summary: French President Macron criticized Israeli actions in the West Bank and Gaza during his UN address on Tuesday, noting Hamas's absence from the West Bank territory where the Palestinian Authority operates. Israel responded by rejecting his characterization.

stories.title: Après la crise, le renouveau du site industriel d’Arkema à Jarrie, en Isère

en.title: After the crisis, renewal of Arkema's industrial site in Jarrie, Isère
en.summary: French chemical company Arkema inaugurated a hydrogen production unit in Isère nearly two years after announcing 154 job cuts at the same facility, investing ten million euros to secure hydrogen peroxide production.

stories.title: L’US Space Force en appelle aux commerciaux pour renforcer sa surveillance du trafic spatial

en.title: The US Space Force appeals to commercial providers to strengthen its space traffic surveillance
en.summary: The US Space Force signed multiple contracts with Northrop Grumman, Impulse Space, and True Anomaly to procure satellites for monitoring space traffic at reduced cost.

stories.title: Exolaunch et Space Cargo Unlimited, premiers clients de la capsule Starfall qui volera avec Starship

en.title: Exolaunch and Space Cargo Unlimited, first customers for SpaceX's Starfall capsule to fly with Starship
en.summary: Exolaunch and Space Cargo Unlimited have reserved flights on SpaceX's Starfall capsule, which will launch aboard Starship beginning in 2029.

stories.title: Aides aux carburants : le gouvernement parie sur le non-recours pour contenir la facture

en.title: Fuel subsidies: government relies on low uptake to control spending
en.summary: The French government expanded a 100-euro fuel aid program to 5.5 million people and added support for fishing, agriculture, and construction sectors, estimating additional costs at 450 million euros based on unused credits and anticipated low program participation.

stories.title: « Il n’y a rien pour les salariés » : faute d'avancées lors des négociations, la grève est maintenue chez SFR

en.title: "There is nothing for employees": lacking progress in negotiations, strike is maintained at SFR
en.summary: SFR unions are maintaining a planned strike after Monday negotiations with a buyer consortium yielded no additional concessions. The unions cite insufficient severance pay and unclear employment guarantees as unresolved issues.
